## Per-WG review status

Per `governance/working-groups.md` §6.2, the joint
proposal is accepted when every affected WG accepts
it (no objections in any WG's 3-day lazy-consensus
window).

- [ ] **WG: [name]** — accepted on [date]
- [ ] **WG: [name]** — accepted on [date]
- [ ] **WG: [name]** — accepted on [date]
- [ ] **All WGs accepted?**

If any WG objects, escalate to the project lead
(Phase 1) or TSC (Phase 2+).

## Process checklist

- [ ] I followed `templates/joint-proposal.md` for
      the proposal body
- [ ] I held (or scheduled) a joint working
      session with all affected WG leads
- [ ] I confirmed the scope and approach with all
      affected WG leads before opening the PR
- [ ] I have run a 3-day lazy-consensus period in
      each affected WG
- [ ] All affected WGs have accepted the proposal
